it.name: NotesQuick
it.subtitle: Note Markdown in una cartella
it.promotionalText: Note in semplici file Markdown, in una cartella che scegli tu. Su Mac nella barra dei menu, su iPhone e iPad con elenco ed editor. Nessun account.
it.description:
NotesQuick tiene le tue note in semplici file di testo Markdown, dentro una cartella che scegli tu. Nessun database, nessun formato proprietario, nessun account: i file restano tuoi e li apri con qualsiasi altra app.

Su Mac vive nella barra dei menu: un clic e hai l'elenco, un altro e stai scrivendo. Su iPhone e iPad trovi le stesse note, con elenco ed editor.

SCRIVERE

• Markdown evidenziato mentre scrivi: titoli, grassetto, corsivo, elenchi, link, codice, citazioni
• Il titolo della nota è la sua prima riga, e il file prende lo stesso nome
• Gli elenchi continuano da soli quando vai a capo
• I #tag vengono riconosciuti nel testo e raccolti sotto la nota
• Salvataggio automatico alla chiusura; le note vuote spariscono da sole

NON SOLO NOTE

• Salva un link: un tocco e si apre nel browser
• Aggiungi file come PDF, immagini e documenti, con anteprima
• Manda testo, link e file a NotesQuick dal menu Condividi delle altre app

RITROVARE

• Ricerca nel titolo e nel contenuto
• Elenco ordinato per ultima modifica, con data breve
• Nascondi un elemento fino a una data, quando non ti serve adesso
• Fatti ricordare un elemento con una notifica

DOVE STANNO I FILE

Scegli una cartella qualsiasi, anche in iCloud Drive o in un altro servizio dell'app File: se la cartella è sincronizzata, le note ti seguono su Mac, iPad e iPhone. Puoi usare l'estensione .md, .markdown o .txt.

PRIVACY

NotesQuick legge e scrive solo nella cartella che scegli tu. Non fa richieste di rete, non ha account, non raccoglie dati.

GRATUITA

L'app è gratuita e completa, senza pubblicità e senza acquisti.

en-US.name: NotesQuick
en-US.subtitle: Markdown notes in a folder
en-US.promotionalText: Notes as plain Markdown files, in a folder you choose. In the menu bar on Mac, with a list and an editor on iPhone and iPad. No account.
en-US.description:
NotesQuick keeps your notes as plain Markdown text files, in a folder you choose. No database, no proprietary format, no account: the files stay yours and open in any other app.

On Mac it lives in the menu bar: one click for the list, another and you are writing. On iPhone and iPad you find the same notes, with a list and an editor.

WRITING

• Markdown highlighted as you type: headings, bold, italic, lists, links, code, quotes
• A note's title is its first line, and the file takes the same name
• Lists continue by themselves when you press Return
• #tags are recognised in the text and collected under the note
• Notes save automatically on close; empty notes go away by themselves

NOT ONLY NOTES

• Save a link: one tap opens it in the browser
• Add files such as PDFs, images and documents, with a preview
• Send text, links and files to NotesQuick from the Share menu of other apps

FINDING THINGS

• Search in titles and content
• List sorted by last change, with a short date
• Hide an item until a date, when you do not need it now
• Get reminded of an item with a notification

WHERE THE FILES LIVE

Pick any folder, including one in iCloud Drive or another service in the Files app: if the folder syncs, your notes follow you across Mac, iPad and iPhone. You can use the .md, .markdown or .txt extension.

PRIVACY

NotesQuick only reads and writes the folder you choose. It makes no network requests, has no account and collects no data.

FREE

The app is free and complete, with no ads and no purchases.

review.notes:
Notes app for Mac, iPhone and iPad. No account, no login, no in-app purchases, no ads, no network requests made by the app.

PURPOSE AND AUDIENCE
NotesQuick keeps notes as plain Markdown text files in a folder the user chooses, plus saved links and files (PDF, images, documents) shown with Quick Look. For anyone who wants quick notes that stay ordinary files.

HOW TO TEST - macOS
The Mac app is a menu bar app: it has no Dock icon and opens no window at launch. Look for the NotesQuick icon (a small page with text lines) on the right side of the menu bar.
1. Click that icon: a panel opens with the list (empty at first: "No items").
2. Click the orange "+" > "New note": an editor window opens. Type a first line (it becomes the title), some Markdown such as "## Heading", "**bold**", "- item", and a "#tag". Close the window: the note is saved and appears in the list.
3. "+" > "Add link…" saves a URL (clicking it opens the browser). "+" > "Add file…" imports a file, previewed with Quick Look.
4. Hover a row: the clock button opens the schedule sheet ("Hide until" / "Remind me on"), the trash button deletes.
5. The "…" button: Preferences… (open at login, notes folder, file extension, hide tags), About, Quit.
No sample files or credentials are needed: by default notes are stored in the app's own Documents folder.

HOW TO TEST - iOS / iPadOS
1. Launch the app: the list is shown. Tap "+" > "New note", type some text, go back: the note is in the list.
2. Swipe a row left to delete, right to schedule. The gear opens Settings (notes folder, file extension, hide tags).
3. From any other app (for example a web page in the browser), Share > NotesQuick saves the link or file as an item.

NOTIFICATIONS
Local notifications only, used for the optional "Remind me on" date of an item. No push notifications, no server.

EXTERNAL SERVICES
None. No backend, no analytics, no third-party SDKs. Apple frameworks only.

REGIONS
Identical everywhere, no geo-gating. Localised in English and Italian.

REGULATED / THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL
Neither applies. The app shows only the user's own files.

SANDBOX AND ENTITLEMENTS
App Sandbox is on. File access is limited to the folder the user picks (user-selected read/write, remembered with a security-scoped bookmark). The App Group is used only to pass items from the Share extension to the app.
